description: Danxbot mantra (zero-context continuity: all work lives on cards or the plan; always the ideal, correct, zero-tech-debt solution) on SessionStart with no matcher, so it re-injects after compaction, plus a one-line pointer on UserPromptSubmit. Then the plugin skill load mandate for danxbot autonomous dispatch + worker runtime environment (SessionStart). Plus the plan event bridge (DX-2784): one background process per session CONNECTED to a danxbot Plan, relaying the plan's dashboard events into the session inbox. An async PostToolUse hook on plan_connect and an async SessionStart hook start it; it runs `danx-dashboard-mcp bridge`, which exits at once for a session not connected to a plan. SessionEnd stops it, but is only an accelerator: the bridge's own periodic check of its Claude process (env var `CLAUDE_PID` — observed on Claude Desktop, but undocumented and not guaranteed by any Claude Code surface) is the SOLE authority on whether the session is still alive, including detecting the pid being reused by an unrelated process (DX-2894). A bridge that cannot see a valid, readable CLAUDE_PID at startup refuses to start rather than running unsupervised.
